units: <cite ref="Megillah 12b:20">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 2:5">Esth. II, 5</cite>) <he>וקרי ליה י׳ וכ׳</he> and the text calls him (Mardecai) a Y’mini which means that he is a descendant of Benjamin.
<cite ref="Esther 2:5">Ib.</cite>, sq. <he>ומה שילם לי י׳</he> and how the Benjamite (Saul) repaid me.
